One three-hump arcade, entered by a connecting hairline from the sign to its left; nothing else inside the box.

One double shape of two back-to-back curves crossing at the middle; a pale upright smear of lighter ink touches its left side, and the first minim of the following arcade is clipped at the right edge.

A small serpentine stroke standing alone at left, then a hooked stroke joined to an open angle with a small loop at upper right and a descender sweeping back left (a combination that recurs joined on other lines, counted as one), led in by a long thin diagonal hairline from lower left.

A group of three zigzag down-up strokes joined at the bottom, the last rising into the top of a stem that descends below the line with a bowl at its right; the stem-with-bowl recurs alone on the page, and the third down-up stroke may be a separate small sign (3 if so); the tip of a curl from the left neighbour enters at the left edge and an arc at the top is from the line above.
